tldr: Jupiter through the 10th house expands career, visibility, reputation, pressure, and ambition.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 10th house, it makes more room around career, visibility, reputation, pressure, ambition, authority, and how you are being seen. You may notice how much attention is on your responsibilities, your public role, or the direction you are trying to build.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a visible choice with more intention.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is measuring your whole self by what is productive, impressive, or approved.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
